summary: All 8 UI-facing acceptance criteria for the personalized AION assistant (Mehmet greeting, hidden-until-triggered chat panel, Pro-text/border removal, local mocked chat flow, voice fallback, mobile responsive chat, and preserved login/theme/logout flows) verified via named browser checks. No new backend API surface was introduced for this feature set (chat responses are local/MOCKED per spec_deviations), so no backend test files were needed.

checks.criterion: AION asistanı masaüstünde kenar boşluksuz tam ekrandır
checks.name: aion-fullscreen-no-margin-desktop
checks.evidence: 1280x720: assistant-home-screen boundingBox x=0,y=0, width>=1279, height>=719 after admin login

checks.criterion: Sohbet başlangıçta gizlidir ve gerektiğinde açılır
checks.name: aion-chat-hidden-until-triggered
checks.evidence: conversation-panel absent from DOM (count=0) right after login; clicking voice-assistant-button opens conversation-panel (visible)

checks.criterion: Pro metni ve composer dikdörtgen border'ı kaldırılmıştır
checks.name: aion-no-pro-text-and-borderless-composer
checks.evidence: body innerText does not contain 'Pro ile daha fazla özelliğe eriş'; .composer-panel computed borderWidth='0px'; chat-message-input focused outlineStyle='none'

checks.name: aion-local-chat-flow-mehmet-response
checks.evidence: Sent 'Merhaba, bir plan yapmama yardım eder misin?' -> sent-message-preview shows user text, conversation-processing-indicator appeared, conversation-message-list later contains 'Mehmet' (local assistant reply)

checks.criterion: Sesli asistan kontrolü güvenli fallback sunar
checks.name: aion-voice-assistant-safe-fallback
checks.evidence: voice-assistant-button/label visible ('AION ile konuş'); click opens conversation-panel with chat-microphone-button visible, conversation-voice-status one of expected fallback/listening states, no pageerror events, home screen remained mounted (no crash)

checks.criterion: Mobil sohbet paneli responsive ve dokunmaya uygundur
checks.name: aion-mobile-chat-panel-responsive-touch
checks.evidence: 390x844: panel hidden pre-trigger, opened via voice-assistant-button, boundingBox width>=385 (full width), message list/close/send/microphone controls all visible; close button removes panel from DOM

checks.criterion: Mevcut erişim ve tema akışları korunmuştur
checks.name: aion-existing-access-and-theme-flows
checks.evidence: admin/AION#2026 login succeeds -> assistant-home-screen visible; sidebar-settings-button toggles theme picker without error; sidebar-logout-button click -> URL '/giris' with login-screen visible
